rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when forcing a person, animal, or occupant out of a place or position.

example.english: That stray dog kept hiding in the back staircase, so we eventually had to dislodge it.
example.traditional: 嗰隻流浪狗成日匿喺後樓梯，我哋最後要趕走佢。
example.jyutping: go2 zek3 lau4 long6 gau2 seng4 jat6 nik1 hai2 hau6 lau4 tai1 ngo5 dei6 zeoi3 hau6 jiu3 gon2 zau2 keoi5

rows.note: Use this for prying a physically secured object loose and removing it from its position.

example.english: The thieves managed to dislodge the air conditioner outside the door in the middle of the night.
example.traditional: 賊人半夜撬走咗門口部冷氣機。
example.jyutping: caak6 jan4 bun3 je6 giu6 zau2 zo2 mun4 hau2 bou6 laang5 hei3 gei1

rows.note: Use this when pressure or circumstances force someone out rather than someone simply chasing them away.

example.english: The landlord’s huge rent increase eventually helped dislodge all the long-term tenants.
example.traditional: 個業主加租加到咁狼，結果逼走晒啲老租客。
example.jyutping: go3 jip6 zyu2 gaa1 zou1 gaa1 dou3 gam3 long4 git3 gwo2 bik1 zau2 saai3 di1 lou5 zou1 haak3
